description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the CheckDueInstallmentsBusinessStep component, especially its handling of loan repayment schedule installments due on the current business date. It uses Mockito for mocking dependencies and JUnit 5 for testing.

classes.name: CheckDueInstallmentsBusinessStepTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CheckDueInstallmentsBusinessStep, testing its behavior with different installment due date scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes thread-local context with tenant, action, and business dates before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: testNoRepaymentScheduleInLoan
methods.description: Verifies that no event is triggered when the loan has no repayment installments.

methods.name: testInstallmentDueDateIsNotMatchingWithCurrentBusinessDate
methods.description: Checks that no event is triggered if the installment due date does not match the current business date.

methods.name: testSingleInstallmentDueDateIsMatchingWithCurrentBusinessDateAndNotFullyPayed
methods.description: Verifies event generation when a single installment is due today and not fully paid.

methods.name: testSingleInstallmentDueDateIsMatchingWithCurrentBusinessDateAndFullyPayed
methods.description: Ensures no event is generated if the installment due date matches but is already fully paid.

methods.name: testMultipleInstallmentDueDateIsMatchingWithCurrentBusinessDateAndNotFullyPayedButSingleEventIsGenerated
methods.description: Checks that only one event is generated even when multiple installments are due today and not fully paid.
